verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 108.6 (-2.2% in a day) and momentum is 37: prices are falling. 84s cost 900, 85s 2,900 and 86s 6,100. The weekend is ending, and prices usually ease into Monday.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-25T18:57:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell João Félix 84 Team of the week after its 17% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 224,000 coins. Now 202,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 16.7% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 1 of 2 so far, averaging +8.3% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Weekend is ending: wait before buying
moves.detail: Prices usually ease as the weekend ends and players sell their squads. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-10-29T07:59:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 900 (1.08 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,900 (1.38 coins per Item Score point), 86s 6,100 (1.49 coins per Item Score point), 87s 8,200 (1.49 coins per Item Score point), 88s 14,750 (1.78 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Thibaut Courtois and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Thibaut Courtois 90 Rare -80.7%; Tahith Chong 85 Ultimate Scream -71.3%; Castello Lukeba 85 Ultimate Scream -58.7%; Serhou Guirassy 86 Star Performer -56.5%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: 1 of 3 79+ Gold Player Pick SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 11.9K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
